name: apprenti.dev Industrial / Edge Software Engineering
audience: Embedded, IIoT, and backend engineers who already write production code and are specializing in resource-constrained and industrial-edge software
philosophy: LEARN BY DOING. GROW THROUGH MENTORSHIP. Design for the budget first: every byte, every tick, and every update path is measured on a host you already have — simulation before silicon, fail-safe before flash.
corePlatforms: GCC or Clang on the host
QEMU (optional; for xv6 and any MCU image the apprentice already has)
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks in this curriculum default to guided AI use: explanations, hints and quizzes are allowed; complete solutions are not.
The apprentice remains accountable for every submitted artifact, including C that an AI tool helped produce.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated understanding and inspectable evidence — a green test run alone is not enough.
